description: This file processes localization coverage data for Excalidraw, generating a markdown table of language translation percentages, flags, and links to Crowdin translations.

methods.name: printHeader
methods.description: Generates the markdown table header for language coverage display.

methods.name: printRow
methods.description: Creates a markdown table row for a specific language's coverage data.

methods.name: boldIf
methods.description: Returns bolded text if condition is true, otherwise plain text.
